checks.result: Before fix, native Enter selection left activeElement BODY. After fix, Enter, arrows, preset, undo and redo retained selected-note focus; Delete focused the vacated cell.

Malformed JSON, overlap, explicit invalid bars and invalid BPM preserved exact original storage bytes while editing. Recovery Blob contained exact original bytes. Explicit replacement saved current valid state and restored it on reload.

Saved phrase without bars restored notes and BPM as one bar without recovery warning.

Denied clipboard write produced a visible selected read-only URL and actionable copy instruction.
